params.name: term
params.description: The search term to query for.

params.name: types
params.description: Comma-separated list of document types to filter results (e.g., software-catalog, techdocs).

params.name: filters
params.description: Key-value filter pairs to narrow search results. Filters are specific to the document type.

params.name: pageCursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination. Obtained from a previous search response.

items.docs: Performs a search query against the Backstage search index. Returns matching documents with their metadata, ranked by relevance. Supports filtering by document type, term-based queries, and cursor-based pagination for large result sets.
